sentences.text: Lisinopril is used to treat high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Lowering blood pressure lowers the risk of fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.

sentences.text: It is also used to ease the signs and symptoms of systolic heart failure.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated to reduce signs and symptoms of systolic heart failure

sentences.text: After a heart attack, it is used to lower the risk of death in patients whose condition is stable.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated for the reduction of mortality in treatment of hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: The doctor sets the dose based on how the blood pressure responds.
sentences.quote: Dosage should be adjusted according to blood pressure response.

sentences.text: Please ask the doctor before using salt substitutes that contain potassium.
sentences.quote: Tell patients not to use salt substitutes containing potassium without consulting their physician.

sentences.text: Heavy sweating, dehydration, vomiting, or diarrhea can make blood pressure drop too low.

sentences.text: People taking it for high blood pressure may get a headache, feel dizzy, or have a cough.

sentences.text: People taking it for heart failure may have low blood pressure or chest pain.
sentences.quote: Heart Failure: hypotension and chest pain (6.1)

sentences.text: Tell the doctor about any light-headedness, especially in the first few days.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report light-headedness especially during the first few days of therapy.

sentences.text: Get help right away for swelling of the face, lips, or tongue, or for trouble swallowing or breathing.

sentences.text: Tell the doctor soon about signs of infection, like a sore throat or fever.

sentences.text: Some older people may be more sensitive to this medicine.
sentences.quote: greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out.

sentences.text: Spironolactone is used to treat serious heart failure.

sentences.text: It is also used along with other medicines to lower high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Use as an add-on therapy for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It can help with swelling from fluid build-up in some adults with liver problems.
sentences.quote: The management of edema in adult patients who are cirrhotic when edema is not responsive to fluid and sodium restrictions

sentences.text: Warfarin helps prevent and treat blood clots in the veins and lungs.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism (PE).

sentences.text: It is also used for clot problems linked to atrial fibrillation or a heart valve replacement.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of thromboembolic complications associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) and/or cardiac valve replacement.

sentences.text: After a heart attack, it helps lower the risk of death, another heart attack, and clots such as stroke.
sentences.quote: Reduction in the risk of death, recurrent myocardial infarction (MI), and thromboembolic events such as stroke or systemic embolization after myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: Take warfarin exactly as the doctor prescribed.
sentences.quote: Take warfarin sodium exactly as prescribed.

sentences.text: Regular blood tests and visits with the healthcare provider are needed to see how the medicine is working.

sentences.text: If a dose is missed, take it as soon as possible that same day, but do not take a double dose the next day.

sentences.text: Keep eating a normal, balanced diet so the amount of vitamin K stays steady.

sentences.quote: Warfarin sodium tablets, USP are contraindicated in women who are pregnant except in pregnant women with mechanical heart valves, who are at high risk of thromboembolism
